```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Prepare data for visualization
# Group by breed and count the number of each breed
breed_counts = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)  # Top 10 breeds

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette='viridis')

# Adding labels and title
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=14)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
